heading: Tuesday, July 21, 2026
topLine: Xiaohongshu and Huawei AI systems reported to score 42/42 at IMO 2026. Also: Google releases Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite.

items.headline: Xiaohongshu and Huawei AI systems reported to score 42/42 at IMO 2026
items.summary: Xiaohongshu (RedNote) said its dots-note-3.0 model, entered at the IMO's invitation, solved all six IMO 2026 problems in natural language for a perfect 42/42. Chinese press reports say IMO officials graded it. Huawei followed on 22 July with its own 42/42 claim, and a statement attributed to IMO President Gregor Dolinar confirmed Huawei's perfect score. The AI systems received the problems after the human contestants had finished and had to answer within the time limit. Other perfect-score claims for commercial models came from informal tests and were not officially graded.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite
items.summary: Gemini 3.6 Flash upgrades 3.5 Flash, and Google says it uses about 17% fewer output tokens and reports 83.0% on OSWorld-Verified. It is priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ($0.30/$2.50) is the fastest 3.5-class model; Google also announced a limited-access 3.5 Flash Cyber model.
